inspection.officer_note: Most of the plot is weedy or bare.

correspondence.msg: Offers a clearing plan over the summer.

deciding.cultivation_breach: Only 24 of 100 m2 is cultivated and there is no exemption. Doubt comes from the previous visit, when 7 of 9 beds were cultivated, and from the tenant's offered plan.
deciding.notice_ladder_met: The warning was served and its deadline has passed, but reinspected_on equals the deadline date (2023-06-04), not after it. The warning is also over a year old.
deciding.next_action: A final notice follows a served and expired warning with a persisting breach. The tenant's plan and the stale, borderline warning make taking no action defensible.
deciding.recurrence_count: The only notice is from 2023-05, more than 12 months before the visit. The previous visit was largely cultivated, so this is a first occurrence.
deciding.uncultivated_extent: The weedy beds (40 m2) and bare beds (36 m2) total 76 m2 of 100 m2, which is just over the 75% line.
